resources.string: Back up and restore your preferences
Save your preferences on this device or sync them securely with your Synapse account.
No local backup yet. Create one to keep a private copy on this device.
A local settings backup is available.
Settings backup saved on this device.
Backup validated. Review the restore preview to continue.
Restoring replaces supported preferences currently on this device. Settings are not merged.
Checking your Synapse account for a backup…
Cloud backups are unavailable in this app configuration.
Sign in to your Synapse account to use cloud backup.
You’re offline. Reconnect to use cloud backup; your local preferences remain available.
No cloud backup yet. Use Back up now to create one.
Cloud backup is available. Settings are up to date.
Local and cloud settings need your choice.
Cloud backup couldn’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
Back up now replaces this account’s previous cloud snapshot. Cloud data is private to your signed-in account.
Settings backed up to your Synapse account.
Settings are synced with your Synapse account.
No cloud backup exists yet. Use Back up now to create one.
Only supported settings are included. Messages, chat history, posts, credentials, API keys, and media files are not backed up.
Both this device and the cloud changed since the last sync. Choose a copy to keep. Choosing cloud replaces settings on this device; choosing this device replaces the cloud snapshot.
The cloud backup was removed while this conflict was open. You can keep this device’s copy.
Your device and cloud settings differ. Choose which copy to keep.
This file is not a valid settings backup. Your current preferences were left unchanged.
This backup version isn’t supported by this app.
File access was denied. Choose the file again and allow access.
Couldn’t read or save the backup. Check available device storage and try again.
You’re offline. Connect to the internet and retry cloud backup.
Cloud backup failed. Your local settings are unchanged; try again.
The signed-in account changed. No cloud settings were applied.
The cloud backup changed while you were reviewing it. Review the latest copy before restoring.
Local settings changed during the operation. They were not overwritten; review and retry.
